name: deskcrit
description: The deskcrit Claude Code plugin, which teaches a coding agent to check its UI work with a design critic.

plugins.name: deskcrit
plugins.description: Two skills: crit-loop teaches a coding agent the fix loop (capture, critique, fix the top findings, and have a fresh critic recheck until no ranked finding is left or the loop stops improving), and design-critic critiques a still image of a design against a checklist of guidelines.
